value.interpretation: Two scales diagnose numerical stability, not LR selection. F retains amax/abs/guards/clamps and float32 parameter rounding; unstableFD is not an AD bug. H-S andS-F are nested functional comparisons with interactions. Initial direction evidence does not prove a later training cause or detector-response fit.

mode_definitions.H: Original canonical hard ADC with dynamic firstargmax crop.
mode_definitions.S: hard0 + (clamp(prelambda)-clamp(pre0)), then prefix mean subtraction and dynamic firstargmax crop; mathematical anchored surrogate, not actual ADC.
mode_definitions.F: Same anchored carrier as S with this bank/H initial hard crop indices; retains clamp/max/abs/guards and float32 parameter effects.

config.actual_direction: Restore exact initial036 train mode, four numpy/six CPU torch states and fresh AdamW3group state. One combinedAD, clip5 and one actual diagnosticAdam update; lambda1 copies actual theta1 exactly, all others independently initial+lambda*(theta1-initial).
config.first_bank: Restore checkpoint states directly, not guessed/regenerated seed states; baseline H AD forward is reused.
config.risk_bank_role: Eight previously examined033 TRAIN diagnostic banks; not fresh confirmation or holdout. First training bank is excluded from8bank paired mean/MCSE.
config.common_random_numbers: Independent SOURCE A/B and REAL T/U streams once per bank. Cache response/005/extension draws and targets; reuse across all points/modes. S/F reuse the same signal/preADC outputs with no additional NN or ADC.
config.FD_interpretation: Two symmetric scales check numerical stability, not LR candidates. Compare F centered differences with g dot real coordinate differences, subtracting stored float32 coordinates only after converting each to double. No unstableFD=>bug rule, no bestlambda or adaptive extra query.
config.mode0_check: Every bank: H/S/F carriers, baseline means, windows and selected peak indices must be elementwise equal at lambda0.
config.statistics: Use initial036 model/loss/integral/carrier_scale tensors; no statistic refit. REAL prepared256 is authoritative after exact one shared CPU existingADC replay.
config.sample_interval_interpretation: Frozen software coordinates, not hardware timing calibration.
config.input_pin_provenance: ROOT035/036 collection byte-SHA metadata and frozen native036 config; no CP deserialization or original array decode during preparation.
